description: Tanzania - Prioritization of locations for off-grid rural electrification is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Demographics, Energy access", published or maintained by Catherina Cader (Reiner Lemoine Institut). The overall objective of this project is to prioritize locations for off-grid rural electrification in Tanzania. Coverage: Tanzania. It has 3 files in SHP, GeoJSON, XLS. The portal files it under Demographics, Energy access. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
